title: Restriction preserves flat-term K-flat constant-field representatives
statement: For any extension F -> B of fields on a small site with the comparison interfaces [def-pur-finite-field-derived-tensor-comparison], restriction of a flat-term K-flat B-complex is a flat-term K-flat F-complex. In fact every complex over the constant field F is a flat-term K-flat representative.

source.place: Tags 06YN, 06YQ and 06YU; sites-modules Tags 03ER and 08FC. The upper-truncation filtered-colimit proof is an agent consequence.

proof.text: Every module sheaf over the constant field is flat, including every term and cycle sheaf in every good upper truncation.

Each good upper truncation is bounded above with flat terms and hence K-flat. The source-library filtrationLE colimit is the original complex. Tensor preserves these colimits, and filtered module-sheaf colimits are exact; the source-library closedUnderColimitsOfShape_kFlat gives K-flatness of the colimit.

Apply preservation of quasi-isomorphisms to the zero map from zero into an arbitrary acyclic complex. Its tensor source is zero, so its tensor target is acyclic. All terms are flat by the first step. Apply this result to the restricted complex.
